It is not fruitful in the windows of the earth."
word_for_word: "Now in all things there is faith; and in all works there is reverence, and unto every thing that is called according to the name of the Lord."
"By unbelief hath he given the havan? by charity?"
"Whatever work is done, it is also included in it."
"For it is not in the world, that it should not be brought forth, but in the earth:"
no iha na cāsmiṃlloke phalati? ayaśaskaratvāt
"Is not this the fruit of the vine? for it is not the fruit that is to be plucked out of the tree."
